svg.text: Standard clustering reads each spot alone. Spatially aware clustering also asks the neighbours.
Each spot is labelled on its own profile
the label uses the surrounding spots too
one noisy spot + its 18 nearest spots
BayesSpace · neighbours pulled to one label
BANKSY · neighbour average as extra features
GraphST · neural net on the neighbour graph
λ = how much the neighbours count
Moderate λ: clean domains, TLS kept
Too much λ: the 7-spot TLS is
⚠️ Smoothness is now partly your input — a coherent domain is no longer evidence by itself. Compare with λ = 0.
💡 The autocorrelation that inflates p-values (§4.3) is exactly the signal these methods use.
